title: Bounded-below filtered Hom continuity for stratified dualizable condensed sheaves
statement:
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and put $B=p_Y^*\Lambda$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(B)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with ordinary relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $K\in D(B)$ admit a finite stratification of $Y$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset], on each of which its derived restriction is dualizable: there are an object $D$ and evaluation $D\otimes K\to B$ and coevaluation $B\to K\otimes D$ with the two contraction composites equal to the identities, using the usual associators and unitors [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], let $C:I\to\operatorname{Ch}(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$ be a diagram of integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and suppose one integer $a$ satisfies $C_i^j=0$ for every $i$ and $j<a$. Write $C_\infty=\varinjlim_i C_i$ for the termwise sheaf-module colimit with legs $\iota_i$, and $Q$ for passage to $D(B)$. For every integer $r$, the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(K,QC_i[r])\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(K,QC_\infty[r]),\qquad [u_i]\longmapsto Q(\iota_i)[r]\circ u_i,$$
is an isomorphism of $\Gamma(*,\Lambda)$-modules. It is natural in $K$ and in morphisms of diagrams. The $C_i$ need not be constructible; no Noetherian or finite-dimensional hypothesis on $Y$ is imposed.
